reformulation: Committed solver-blind reformulation: 17,264/21,235 -> 5,528/5,799 vars/rows. 12,011 capacity auxiliaries and their 12,286 rows are replaced by 275 continuous penalty variables and 983 exact cost-epigraph rows (22 threshold rows certified nonpositive on the bound box); 6,179 pairwise conflict rows become 2,046 verified cliques; 2,645 day/shortfall/isolation auxiliaries are relaxed to continuous but retain bounds and rows. Preserves the 2,608 primary binary assignments and the minimum auxiliary completion cost per assignment (projected objective epigraph), not the auxiliary solution set.
claim_class: 3 claims, no bijection and no points: (1) forward integer map, objective Equal, 2,608 primary observations; (2) reverse integer map, objective NonIncreasing; (3) reverse LP map, input_integers=output_integers=false. Claims 2 and 3 are the opposing nonincreasing maps that give equality of extended infima per integer primary assignment; request.json holds only this contract (87,585 B), never the edit list.
claims: cases/test72/request.json (87,585 B) = 3 claims, each with a 2,608-pair projection plus reverse/input_integers/output_integers/objective flags; claim 1 is objective 'Equal', claims 2-3 'NonIncreasing' and inverse null (tools/prepare_test72.py:366).

Claim 1 forward (15,761,043 B RPA, work 3,189,350; work_profile.json claims[1]): 983 epigraph Lin steps, 2,046 exhaustive clique Case trees, no lift wave (preparation.json counts.lift_wave_schedule_by_claim[0] = []).
Claim 2 reverse integer (199,777,423 B RPA, work 109,081,571) is the size driver: two MenuLift waves of 11,084 and 120 menus plus the 12,011 lambda prefix-count derivations; blocks[1] depth 17.

Claim 3 reverse LP (13,221,915 B RPA, work 44,212,153): 21 IntervalLift waves (275,173,125,115,86,60,43,35,24,21,18,15,9,6,516,670,1080,...) generating 12,011 interval variables and 50,871 rows; the bounded-sum distribution is split by 7 hand-written balanced rounds (:339-357).

Contract wording (preparation.json claims): forward capacity threshold identities are integrality-free, but no source-LP-to-target-LP map is certified because the forward clique proof needs binary Cases - negative check 'false_forward_lp' is INVALID for exactly that request.
proof_encoding: proof.rpa = 'RPA 7' + one compactly serialized certificate: 228,760,321 B = 218.2 MiB = 85.2% of the 268,435,456 B (256 MiB) RPA/request text limit; proof.rpx = 196,622,652 B; request.json = 87,585 B (preparation.json rpa_bytes/rpx_bytes/artifacts).

Measured byte split of the RPA: block1 forward 15.73 MB (steps 15.04 + Return 0.69), block2 reverse integer 199.75 MB (steps 190.69 + Return 9.06), block3 reverse LP 13.20 MB (steps 11.26 + Return 1.94) - matching the per-claim profile files (15,761,043 / 199,777,423 / 13,221,915 B).

Structure census by streaming the file: 438,320 Lin, 49,171 Cases, 16,694 Absurd, 11,204 menu witnesses, 21 IntervalLift + 2 MenuLift waves, 3 Returns; 3,306,974 VarLower, 382,132 VarUpper and 1,031,049 VarInt coefficient references are inlined as text, ~95% of them inside the reverse-integer block.

Kernel verify statistics (preparation.json verify_statistics): obligations 155,805, linear_terms 20,195,433, substitution_terms 1,996,426, branches 49,171, peak_live_facts 112,076, work 156,483,074, menu_generated_variables 300,425, menu_generated_rows 22,408, interval_generated_variables 12,011, interval_generated_rows 50,871.

How it stays under the limit - all manual: separators=(',',':') on the dump (:386), expressions as {'constant','terms':[[index,coef]]} so names live only in the MCM (prepare_test40.py:81), obligation targets stored once in Return.checks while steps carry only coefficient references (prepare_test88.py:43), and an in-process fact cache keyed by (kind, signature(expr)) (prepare_test48.py:22,25). No size guard exists: rpa_bytes is recorded (:392) and never compared.
agent_manual_work: All exact arithmetic and modelling done in 14 eval cells / 51,670 code chars (digest census): hand-written MPS parser over 145,871 lines with Fraction, section/vector-count/bound-coverage asserts, incidence partition and duplicate-row signature scans.

Wrote its own clique enumeration after `import networkx` failed (the run's single failing tool call, digest 'Enumerating verified conflict cliques'): pivoted Bron-Kerbosch plus independent per-pair witness and complete edge-coverage check - 6,179 edges, 2,100 maximal cliques, 2,046 nontrivial, 8,649 pair incidences.

Verification by hand: exhaustive incidence signatures for all 12,011 auxiliaries, exact certificates at all 1,005 block/weight thresholds, bound maxima for the 22 omitted rows, 67,580 exhaustive count vectors (214 blocks) + 6,190 boundary profiles (61 blocks), 13,292 isolation and 3,715 day-presence cases (digest 'Verifying epigraph identities' / 'Exercising exact reformulation identities').

Emitted a 4.6 MB audit.json manifest (275 capacity_blocks with per-lambda primary/upper_row/cost, 2,046 clique_rows with original_edge_rows, 18,465 removed_rows, 12,011 removed_variables, 2,645 relaxed_integer_variables) - the only binding between target and claim.

Wrote the target MPS itself (3,693,280 B, eval 'Writing single committed formulation') and a separate 10,950 B verify.py with its own row-oriented parser that reconstructs the target from the manifest; run once in a fresh subprocess, exit 0 / PASS.
preparer_helpers: tools/prepare_test72.py is 443 lines with 45 def sites and imports 13 helpers from 5 sibling preparers: parse_mps/row_ref (prepare_affine.py:20,77), expression/plus/mul/expr_json/row_fact/substitute/sha (prepare_test40.py:72-89,147), Proof/emit_checks (prepare_test48.py:14,106), rounded (prepare_test78.py:41), combine (prepare_test21.py:22) - 1,318 imported lines in total.

Layers (:18-37) owns lift bookkeeping and model extension: menus() writes MenuWitness JSON {'maximum_index','activation','index','checks':['Exact','Exact','Exact',lo,hi,integer]} and appends 300,425 menu variables and 22,408 extension rows straight into the in-memory model (:27-32), carrying counter/facts/lookup across waves (:24).

12 hand-written rule helpers: integer_fact/bounds/fix/exhaustive/evaluated (:39-68) for Case trees over bit facts, menu_zero/menu_segment/menu_function (:69-103) for piecewise-linear menu facts, min_eq/function_fact (:128-141), checked_intervals (:293-302) for IntervalLift premises and free variables.

reverse_integer (:142-292, 150 lines) hand-derives the eliminated variables: cost-ordered prefix sums, one MenuLift per prefix past K, VarLower/VarUpper domain facts, per-lambda Cases trees, cost-threshold Cases over group boundaries and the objective Lin step.

execute (:388-438) re-implements the whole delivery pipeline per case: 2 canonical calls, assemble, verify, 4 mutation negatives, determinism re-assemble, 2 re-verifies, a hand-derived work budget ((work*115+999999999)//1e9*1e7 at :425) and a re-verify under --work 180,000,000.
friction: The byte budget is unbudgeted: 218.2 MiB against a 256 MiB text parser limit (85.2%), a single claim at 199.78 MB (74.4%), and sibling cases/test36/proof.rpa already at 267,140,625 B (99.5%); the preparer records rpa_bytes and never tests it, and no CLI form splits a certificate (write_rpa :384, one assemble + one verify :407-412).

Every record of the 4.6 MB audit manifest is consumed as a loose dict and resolved by name into source indices (a['var_index'][...], a['row_index'][...] throughout :142-363) with no schema check; the kernel never reads the manifest, it only hashes it (preparation.json audit.sha256).

Failure localisation over 155,805 obligations is index-only: 4 verify runs exited 2 with 'INVALID obligation mismatch: expected Le; obligation 16159' (and obligation 0), with nothing naming the generator loop, so the mutated-certificate checks can only be debugged by editing templates.

Resource budgets are defended by hand and after the fact: block_depth and wave_schedule (:370-382) exist only to report depths [7,17,22], and the reverse-LP allocation split uses 7 balanced rounds precisely because a linear chain would nest 78 lifts (:339).

Repetition is structural, not algebraic: the 3 claims reserialize the same 2,608-pair projection, the two reverse claims re-derive the same prefix-count justifications per lambda (190.69 MB of steps carrying ~3.1M coefficient refs), and the 9.06 MB Return of claim 2 re-inlines every substituted source row (21,235 rows x up to 78 prefix sums).
notes: Compactness is achieved entirely by hand: literal 'Exact' collapse in Proof.prove, signature-keyed fact cache, index-only expression encoding, one target expression per obligation, and menu/interval wave reuse. The case is the second-largest certificate in the corpus yet its request is 85.5 KB, so the whole size story is generator-side; adding one more clique size or a 79-term block would exceed the 256 MiB text parser limit with no split fallback.
